fields.assessment_notes: Shadow Realm Collectibles now reads as a real nearby Bell Gardens TCG store with broader current Magic coverage than the earlier Commander-only read implied. A fresh Wizards/EventLink pull supports Monday Commander Night, Wednesday Standard Showdown, and Thursday Two-Headed Giant Commander-style play. Existing Linktree, review, Apple Maps, and non-MTG organized-play evidence support active operation and event-hosting capability. The personal-fit caution is still meaningful: the Magic rows use paid-entry, participation-pack, prize-pool, and top-placement language, so Shadow may be more structured or prize-oriented than the user's ideal relaxed casual Commander lane. Treat it as a plausible nearby Magic option to watch, especially for structured play, but not yet a top casual home-base candidate until social/community content clarifies turnout, power level, proxy norms, and solo-arrival behavior.

operations.reason: Reflect fresh Wizards evidence that Shadow has broader current Magic coverage while preserving the structured/prize-oriented fit caution.
